title: The 100M Frame
equation: Scale Readiness = Future Vision × System Durability × Founder Independence
hook: The way you run things works at five clients. It probably breaks at fifty.
statement: Picture the $10M or $100M version of your business. It shows you which of today's systems won't last.
explainer: You can approve everything yourself right now. At scale, that's impossible. Imagining the bigger version makes the hidden weak spots obvious before they actually break.
sop: Pick a future size, like $10M or $100M.
List the systems, people, margins, and offers that version needs.
Compare that list to how you run things today.
Score Future Vision, System Durability, and Founder Independence from 1 to 10.
Upgrade one bottleneck at a time.
equation_example: Future Vision 7, System Durability 3, Founder Independence 2. 7 × 3 × 2 = 42 Scale Readiness, out of 1,000. Higher means today's business could hold tomorrow's size. Lower means your current setup would crack under 10x growth.
question: Write down one thing the $100M version of your business would refuse to keep doing.
closing_statement: Build for the business you're becoming.
caption:
